adapter.label: ngrok HTTPS edge
adapter.needs: Needs an ngrok account, its auth token and a reserved domain.

address.scope: reserved domain of your ngrok account
conditions: a reserved domain is a per-user setup value
the listener lives only while the host process runs

cost.summary: ngrok has a $0 Free plan with one development domain, but its pricing page says custom domains need Pay-as-you-go ($20 base).

disclosure.text: Serve this app through an ngrok listener on your reserved ngrok domain while the app runs. The ngrok edge terminates TLS and can read payloads. The auth token stays in Gozar’s private store.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. the attached controller (packages/gozar-node/attached-route.mjs, runAttachedController) forwards the SDK listener to a gate it runs in front of the app. Before it reports a published origin it runs the same timed-SSE validation as recipe routes (gate.verify with sse) through the public origin. Frames must arrive unbuffered and in order, or the listener is closed and the route fails with verification_failed. Red test: test/adapters/ngrok-attached-validation.test.mjs
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr: the reserved domain is a stable HTTPS origin and the configured authority is preserved.
